$comment: Shared config for the quenching OKF validation hook. Commit this file into the target repo's .claude/hooks/. Per-developer overrides go in hooks-config.local.json (gitignored). All knobs read by cq knowledge.

okfValidate.$comment: The bundle root is the fixed /.knowledge/ convention — no config names it. enabled:false makes the hook inert. warnAsError promotes recommended-field warnings to failures. blockOnFail escalates the PostToolUse/Stop PROPOSAL to decision:block (feeds the reason back to Claude). hardBlock turns ON the PreToolUse deny gate (blocks writing an index.md with a concept type, or a concept doc with no type) — off by default (propose-only). deadlineMs bounds the Stop full-bundle scan (aborts it mid-walk, preserving the dirty marker). stopScan: 'dirty' (default) runs the Stop sweep only when a /.knowledge/** file was edited since the last completed scan; 'always' restores the unconditional every-turn sweep.
